title: 美国派对上不知道聊什么？闲聊英语大全
summary: 美国派对上 small talk 是必备技能。这篇教你安全话题、夸人技巧，以及想结束聊天时的得体说法。

phrases.en: What do you do for work?
It was nice talking to you.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.en: Pretty good! Busy with work. What do you do?
dialogue.zh: 挺好的！工作挺忙。你是做什么的？

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.en: I'm an engineer. By the way, your backyard is amazing!
dialogue.zh: 我是工程师。顺便说，你家后院太棒了！

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.en: Thank you! We just redid it last summer. How do you know Mike?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢！我们去年夏天刚翻修。你怎么认识 Mike 的？

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.en: Our kids are in the same class. Anyway, it was nice talking to you!
dialogue.zh: 我们孩子同班。跟你聊天很愉快！

seoTitle: 美国派对闲聊英语怎么说？
seoDescription: 美国派对上不知道聊什么？本文教你 small talk 的安全话题和夸人技巧，附完整对话。
